phrases.text: A few days ago, I went to the store.

translations.es: Hace unos días, fui a la tienda.
translations.en: A few days ago, I went to the store.

phrases.text: I will do it right now.

translations.en: I will do it right now.

phrases.text: See you the day after tomorrow.

translations.en: See you the day after tomorrow.

phrases.text: I haven't seen him for a long time.

translations.es: No lo he visto en mucho tiempo.
translations.en: I haven't seen him for a long time.

phrases.text: We need to leave in ten minutes.

translations.en: We need to leave in ten minutes.

phrases.text: I have been busy all day long.

translations.es: He estado ocupado todo el día.
translations.en: I have been busy all day long.

phrases.text: Call me when you are ready to go.

translations.es: Llámame cuando estés listo para ir.
translations.en: Call me when you are ready to go.
